title: Connect experiments, joint attention, GTD and personal practice in a shared workbench
summary: The user requests a shared workbench connecting quantitative and qualitative experiment evidence, exposition study, exact references and joint attention, capability search, GTD, blockers, periodic review, personal spaced practice and evidence-informed LLM stewardship. Direction is accepted; no new implementation run, UI, background agent or scheduled automation has started.
